meta.name: deck-presenter-mode
meta.description: tokyo-night 默认主题, T 切换 5 主题, S 打开提词器 popup

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 切换幻灯片主题并打开提词器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用终端制作或展示幻灯片
copy.tagline_en: Switch slide themes and open teleprompter
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often create or present slides in terminal

howto.what: Claude 会做一种给怕忘词的演讲者用的幻灯片：每页带 150–300 字逐字稿 notes，右下角有小工具栏，按 S 弹出提词器窗口，里面有当前页、下一页、稿子、计时四张卡。
howto.when: 当你要做带讲稿的现场演示 deck，或提到提词器、演讲者模式、逐字稿等需求时接管。

say.text: 做一份 16:9 的演讲者模式 deck，每页带逐字稿 notes
say.note: 产出带提词器弹窗的幻灯片

say.text: 按 T 帮我切换主题
say.note: 在 5 套主题间切换，默认 tokyo-night

say.text: 按 S 打开提词器
say.note: 弹出当前页/下一页/稿子/计时卡片

howto.what_en: Claude builds a presenter-mode deck for speakers who fear forgetting lines: each slide carries a 150–300 word script in notes, and a bottom-right toolbar where S opens a teleprompter popup with current, next, script and timer cards.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a live presentation deck with speaker script, or mention teleprompter, presenter mode or verbatim notes.

say_en.text: Make a 16:9 presenter-mode deck with script notes on every slide
say_en.note: Produces slides plus a teleprompter popup

say_en.text: Press S to open the teleprompter
say_en.note: Popup shows current, next, script, timer cards
